newsitem.title: USA: Dow Industrials sharply higher in morning trade.
newsitem.headline: Dow Industrials sharply higher in morning trade.

text.p: The Dow Industrials surged 50 points in early trading on Monday, mostly on excitement generated by the $13 billion merger deal between McDonnell Douglas Corp and Boeing Co.
The New York Stock Exchange said it set its curbs on index-arbitrage trades at 0945/1445 GMT when the Industrials surged 50 points, or 0,80 percent, to 6355.
Advances led declining issues by 10 to six.
